issue.title: DSV files are not sourced in binary workspace
issue.body:
## Bug report

**Required Info:**

- Operating System:
  - Ubuntu 24.04
- Installation type:
  - binaries
- Version or commit hash:
  - latest jazzy (ros2cli is 0.32.1)
- DDS implementation:
  - default (fastdds)

#### Steps to reproduce issue
Install a package that uses dsv to generically modify environment variables as described [here](https://colcon.readthedocs.io/en/released/developer/environment.html#dsv-files).
E.g. [qml_ros2_plugin](https://github.com/StefanFabian/qml_ros2_plugin/blob/master/environment_setup.dsv.in)

#### Expected behavior
The variable QML2_IMPORT_PATH exists and has the added value as defined in the dsv after the binary is ` ros-jazzy-qml-ros2-plugin` is installed and the setup.bash is sourced.

#### Actual behavior
The variable is missing and based on my investigation .dsv environment hooks are generally not processed.
issue.bodyHTML:
Bug report

Required Info:

  • Operating System:
    • Ubuntu 24.04
  • Installation type:
    • binaries
  • Version or commit hash:
    • latest jazzy (ros2cli is 0.32.1)
  • DDS implementation:
    • default (fastdds)

Steps to reproduce issue

Install a package that uses dsv to generically modify environment variables as described here.
E.g. qml_ros2_plugin

Expected behavior

The variable QML2_IMPORT_PATH exists and has the added value as defined in the dsv after the binary is ros-jazzy-qml-ros2-plugin is installed and the setup.bash is sourced.

Actual behavior

The variable is missing and based on my investigation .dsv environment hooks are generally not processed.

comments.body:
A working fix would be to change the following block in the `_local_setup.py` (currently line 253) in `/opt/ros/jazzy` from

```python
           # group remaining source lines by basename
            path_without_ext, ext = os.path.splitext(remainder)
            assert ext.startswith('.')
            ext = ext[1:]
            if ext in (primary_extension, additional_extension):
                if path_without_ext not in basenames:
                    basenames[path_without_ext] = set()
                basenames[path_without_ext].add(ext)
```

to 

```python
           # group remaining source lines by basename
            path_without_ext, ext = os.path.splitext(remainder)
            assert ext.startswith('.')
            ext = ext[1:]
            if ext in (primary_extension, additional_extension, "dsv"):
                if path_without_ext not in basenames:
                    basenames[path_without_ext] = set()
                basenames[path_without_ext].add(ext)
```

However, this looks to be a bit of a hack, and there is probably a cleaner solution.
I honestly don't understand the logic behind the code in some parts of that file.
It could probably use some refactoring.

comments.body: This seems similar to https://github.com/ament/ament_package/issues/145, and I believe it's fixed by https://github.com/ament/ament_package/pull/147. But that's only available in `rolling`, so the temporary work around we use in gz_vendor packages (e.g. https://github.com/gazebo-release/gz_sim_vendor/blob/1c2182a5991f2e83dc10e723303ce920e116bceb/CMakeLists.txt#L91-L95) is to create a dummy `.sh` file with the same name as the `.dsv` file.
